item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 24/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Meanwhile, broad bands of clouds will cover southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea. An intense northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong over the weekend. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region. The weather will be rather cool over the Lunar New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 25/01 (Tuesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Cool in the morning with one or two rain and mist patches. Sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
